LanguageData.RKU_FactoryDefense_Completed.dialogueTex: Comrades, we thank you for protecting the factory! Your timely help saved our only production site. Without it, we would have been forced underground to recover. We will always remember this kindness. But the war is not over. As long as warlords oppress this land, we cannot rest. Let us keep fighting with steady resolve!
LanguageData.RKU_FactoryDefense_Completed_WarlordDefe: Comrades, at last we can end the war... Despite all challenges, we have crushed the warlords. The Kingdom's strength is broken. Now the Acacia heirs see victory's dawn. For over ten years, our Ratkin people have endured civil strife. We veterans must lay down our arms. We want to give our children a future free from conflict. The Partisan cause no longer needs warriors like me. It needs a leader to guide reconstruction and growth. I ask if your colony might offer a position to one... who is still fairly competent as a Mechanitor. How strange that I already look forward to the peace of retirement, haha.
LanguageData.RKU_FactoryDefense_Failed.dialogueText: The factory is lost... We must pull back now and fade into the shadows. From the depths, we will keep fighting. This battle did not go our way, but our will is firm. When we regroup and gather our strength, we will contact you again. So, farewell...
LanguageData.RKU_LeaderJoined_WithZiggyCard.dialogueT: You may wonder why I stay. Do not ask. These are mere details~
LanguageData.RKU_ResearchProgressA.dialogueText: Now press onward, dear scientist. We are analyzing the data.
LanguageData.RKU_ResearchProgressB.dialogueText: These peculiar mushrooms from ancient ruins grow only in unique environments and in small amounts. They are hazardous but with special use.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventB.dialogueText: Calm down. Now tell the story carefully.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventC.dialogueText: Our Partisan movement began with a Kingdom revolution over ten years ago. Under our revered leader Acacia, we freed more than half the sovereign's lands. But these victories were lost after Acacia fell ill and passed. Her successor Sycamore later betrayed our cause for personal power. That story, however, comes later.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventD.dialogueText: The Great Ratkin Pestis struck. It hit our Partisan forces hard. We learned it was man-made. We found those responsible. They paid the price. But we can never bring back the lost.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDA.dialogueText: Have you seen the Kingdom's slave caravans? They still cling to their vile trade.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDB.dialogueText: The "Ratkin Demonmans" commando team started in the civil war as an elite unit. It was first made only of Ratkin Subjects. Their simple ways are deeply moving.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDC.dialogueText: Tell me, did your young colony ever raid merchant caravans in its early days? Just joking. We keep strict discipline here. Even taking one ear of corn from a villager requires payment. We make sure to pay for it.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDD.dialogueText: Do not let the Ratkin aristocracy's fine looks move you. Their noble appearance means nothing. If you saw good people die by their blades, it would shatter any illusions.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDE.dialogueText: You may want to learn about our late leader's philosophy. Varnara Acacia is gone, but her spirit stays with us. It feels like she never left.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDF.dialogueText: Many Gardeners and common soldiers only serve the rich and powerful because they must. When I can, I always try to bring these lost souls into our ranks.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDG.dialogueText: Have you heard the Glitterworld tales? It is a distant, fanciful legend. Sometimes I let myself dream. I imagine Ratkin living carefree among the stars. But that dream is too far from our harsh reality.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDH.dialogueText: War taught us to value cleanliness. We mastered keeping things clean. But our enemies' evil always goes beyond what we can imagine.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDI.dialogueText: Not all aristocrats are our enemies. Some nobles can be won over to our side. Others may join our cause or learn to change their ways. But we must know who our real enemies are. This is crucial.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDJ.dialogueText: Kingdom nobles always use rare flowers to show their status. They fill their estates with blooms. But true gems hide in the rough stone. They only shine for those with idealistic hearts.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDK.dialogueText: I on behalf of all partisans salute you. Your help has been invaluable so far. I think you would be proud to see how our movement grows now.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDL.dialogueText: The Church? I have no faith in such things. There is no important god. We don't need vague ideas to cloud our minds. It's especially foolish when their main god appears as a frog.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventDM.dialogueText: "My warriors want to visit you. May they come?
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventE.dialogueText: We dislike the warlords, but we share the same roots from the revolution. Some abandoned the uprising's goals. They became oppressors themselves. The Kingdom now stands at the edge of collapse. If the warlords' wars would end, we might find peace. But our Partisan forces cannot do this alone. We must be honest about that.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyEig.dialogueText: We will give your land to the homeless and use your body to fertilize the soil!
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyEle.dialogueText: I remember every soul who begged me for vengeance with their last breath... This fills me with a deep rage!
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyEleB.dialogueText: Why do you stay here? Are you enjoying this show you are putting on?
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyEleC.dialogueText: Even butchers show more mercy than you... We will pay you back a hundred times over.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyEleD.dialogueText: Every time I see you, I wish hell were real. Either you fall, or I fall. If I fall into that abyss, I could see their faces again.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyFif.dialogueText: We will watch your every move closely.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyFifA.dialogueText: We still have time to discuss our matters. We trust you will give a satisfactory account in time.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyFifB.dialogueText: Do not see us as a small faction to be crushed. We will prove our claims through our actions.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyFifC.dialogueText: Survival is no excuse for such actions.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyFifD.dialogueText: Have you any further comments to tell?
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyFor.dialogueText: We hope this is the last of your crimes.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyNin.dialogueText: Your attackers are on their way. Lock your doors tonight or you will have reason to cry out!
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemySec.dialogueText: We will not forget what happened. Remember that.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemySix.dialogueText: Wretched bandits! You will not escape what is coming!
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemySixA.dialogueText: You are no better than the Royal Army. In truth, you are worse.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemySixB.dialogueText: Do you claim not to know what you've done? How dare you contact me like this.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemySixC.dialogueText: When I see our wounded comrades, you know who I think of. You know the answer.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemySixD.dialogueText: Do you enjoy watching Ratkin die? Do you like seeing their blood and tears? I have met many like you. I can see it in you.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyThi.dialogueText: Show us your good faith. Or our Partisans will have to act.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventEnemyThir.dialogueText: You killed half of us! You have no idea how splendid these girls and boys were ...You will meet them in hell!
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventF.dialogueText: Do you know the white-furred Ratkin? The Kingdom made them in labs. They share family names and similar features. They move with great agility. Once they were the Kingdom's most deadly secret assassins. But that story is over. One of them joined us and killed her own creator.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventBuildNewSite.dialogueTex: Connection established. Signal clear... Did you miss me?
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventFir.dialogueText: Connection established. Signal clear... Did you miss me?
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventFor.dialogueText: For driller maintenance, see our Commissars. They have rigorous mechanical exams.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventG.dialogueText: We have our own mechanized forces. Right now we only operate one Mechanoid salvaged from the ruins...
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventH.dialogueText: Have you eaten? It's a blessing to have secure food. We're always worried about our supplies...
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventHA.dialogueText: We had a member who used to shine shoes for aristocrats as a child. He grew up to become our best fighter... But I'm getting off track.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventI.dialogueText: Command is a heavy burden. So many young lives depend on my choices. But enough of that. What needs our attention?
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventJ.dialogueText: I know how to cook mushrooms. Overcook them by seconds and they become dangerous.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventK.dialogueText: Are you asking about Hyacinth? That name is common among us. We have over seventy in our regiment alone. Which one do you mean? Tell me more details.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventThi.dialogueText: Would you like to explore the tunnels? The air is stale down there, but we know the paths well. Bring your own supplies and stay close. I can send a guide if you need one.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventZero.dialogueText: The Royal Army frequency channel is silent. They want nothing from you for now.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventZeroA.dialogueText: We thank you for your compassion. All is secure now.
LanguageData.RKU_StartupEventZeroB.dialogueText: Do not interfere in matters that do not concern you. We do not yet have enough trust for such actions.
